verdict.rationale: n8n's public REST API is URL-path versioned (/api/v1), and the docs state the version number and that more versions may come. However, the evidence explicitly reports no API-specific deprecation or stability policy and no public-API changelog, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a stability guarantee, a public-API changelog, and more than one API version to show versioning in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API version number is `1`. There may be multiple versions available in the future.
versioned base URLs for Cloud (https://<your-instance>.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1) and self-hosted instances
